item.title: Monday, September 14
item.description: Every good disaster starts with somebody deciding a bad idea is actually a great one. Strasbourg, July 1518, a woman named Frau Troffea steps into the street and starts dancing. Not fun dancing. Not wedding dancing. The kind of dancing where your feet bleed through your shoes and you keep going anyway. item.title: Saturday, September 12
item.description: Picture London in July of 1858, when the Thames stopped being a river and started being a punishment. Decades of raw sewage had baked in the summer heat until the smell rolled off the water like a physical wall. Members of Parliament, sitting right on the riverbank, soaked their curtains in chloride of lime and still gagged through debates. Newspapers called it the Great Stink, which undersells it...
